faq.description: Quickly find answers to your questions. If you can't find what you're looking for, don't hesitate to contact us.
faq.contactDescription: Our team is here to help you

questions.q1: What kinds of projects do you take on?
questions.a1: We build websites, mobile apps, backend systems, and AI solutions — from a simple showcase site to a complex product.
questions.a2: Java/Spring Boot, React/Next.js, React Native, Python, and cloud tools like AWS, Docker, Vercel.
questions.a3: We start with a needs analysis and a technical proposal, then build in agile sprints, test, and deploy to production with follow-up.
questions.a4: From 2 to 4 weeks for a showcase site, and several months for a complex application. We set a clear schedule.
questions.a5: Yes. Our maintenance contracts include updates, bug fixes, and technical support.
questions.q6: How do I get a quote?
questions.a6: Through our contact form or by email. We review your needs and send a proposal within 48 hours.
